settings.question_1: Q: “Will your template be fully compatible with Shopify?”
settings.question_2: Q: “What is included in the theme package?”
settings.answer_2:
Please make sure that you follow below steps:

1/ Download the package from themeforest.net (The file is in zip format)

2/ Extract the file you've just downloaded (Don't forget this step).

3/ Find this file: ella-x.x.x-sections-ready.zip in the folder Ella Sections Ready x.x.x, then you just need to upload ella-x.x.x-sections-ready.zip file to your Shopify store.

- If you would like to use Ella RTL version. Please find this file: ella-x.x.x-sections-ready-rtl.zip in the folder Ella Sections Ready x.x.x RTL, then you just need to upload ella-x.x.x-sections-ready-rtl.zip file to your Shopify store

- If you want to install child theme, please go to the corresponding theme folder
settings.question_3: Q: “Do you guys offer a refund or exchange?”
settings.answer_3:
To save your time and reach our support quickly, please follow below steps:

  • Create a staff account for us (with Themes permission and Settings permission) http://docs.shopify.com/manual/settings/account/staff-members
  • Capture screenshot or video for the issue you get.
  • Specify which template and version you are using.
  • Describe clearly how to reproduce the issue.
  • Send all information (staff account, screenshot, video, template name and version, description of the issues, link) to email@domain.com
settings.question_4: Q: “Would assistance be available to upload the template if needed?”
settings.answer_4: Yes, we will assist you to install the template if needed
settings.question_5: Q: “Do you guys offer customisation services for your themes?”
settings.answer_5: Yes, we do. Please send your customisation requests to email@domain.com, we will give you our quote. Thank you.
settings.question_6: Q: “Do you guys provide customer support during weekends / holidays?”
settings.answer_6: Normally we don't provide support during weekends, except for urgent cases. In these cases, you only need to mark “Urgent” in your email, we will get back to you ASAP.
settings.question_7: Q: “What I have to do when I need your support?”
settings.answer_7:
1/ Create a staff account for us (with Themes permission and Settings permission) http://docs.shopify.com/manual/settings/account/staff-members

2/ Capture screenshot or video for the issue you get.

5/ Submit a support ticket at here: https://halosoft.ticksy.com/. Our support team will get back to you soonest, please help us to wait.

settings.faqs_text:
Below FAQ are some common concerns of our clients before purchasing the theme.
If you have other questions, please just send it to example@domain.com.
settings.faqs_message_text:
If you have an issue or question that requires immediate assistance, you can click the button below to chat live with a Customer Service representative.

If we aren’t available, drop us an email and we will get back to you within 20-36 hours!

settings.question: Do I need to have an account to shop with you?
settings.answer: You can shop from our online store without creating an account and can place an order with guest checkout. However, creating an account will make your shopping process easier.

settings.question: How do I create an account?
settings.answer: Click on ‘Create an Account’ mentioned on our homepage, you will be promoted to a page on which you will be required to fill out personal details in order create your account.

settings.question: How can I change my shipping address?
settings.answer: Yes, you can edit or add a new shipping address by logging in to your account. Please sign in and click on ‘My Account’. You will be able to edit/update your details in your account and save them for future orders. In case your order is confirmed and you wish to change the delivery address, please contact our customer service immediately. The requested change will be carried out in case the order is not processed.

settings.question: What if I forget my password?
settings.answer: Click on ‘Forgot Your Password’ available at the login/sign-up page. Enter your email address and click on ‘Reset Password’. A set of instructions will be sent to your registered email ID to re-set your password. After your credentials have been verified, you will be able to create a new password.

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer:
Following are the steps to place an order successfully: 

1. When browsing through our web, you can enter the quantity in the tab provided next to the product you wish to buy and click ‘add to cart’. You can add as many items as you wish to buy.

2. After you have finished browsing and click on ‘proceed to checkout’ you will be promoted to a page on which you shall pick a payment method (different payment methods are available as addressed in FAQs below)

3. You will receive an email/SMS of sales invoice which verifies that we have received your order

4. Your order will be confirmed via phone call by our Customer Service and proceeded for delivery

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer: You will be provided with a tracking ID in order to keep a track of your order. Domestic orders normally take 7-10 days to arrive; whereas, international orders normally take 14-20 days.

settings.question: Can I cancel my order?
settings.answer: Your order cannot be cancelled once you check out. However, you can cancel the order when you receive a verification call from our Customer Service representative. Exchange policy apply once the order has been placed.

settings.question: Do you take orders over phone call or WhatsApp?
settings.answer:
Yes, you can place your order on WhatsApp or phone call on our number

 +92328 1667890. Please ensure to provide the article number, color and size of the product you wish to purchase.

settings.question: What does it mean if I don’t receive a sales invoice via email/SMS after I check-out?
settings.answer: If you haven’t received a sales invoice via email within an hour it means your order hasn’t been successfully placed.

settings.question: How will I know the status of my order?
settings.answer: You can contact our customer service to know the status of your order. Helpline/WhatsApp: +92328-1667890

settings.question: What is the difference between order ID and tracking ID?
settings.answer: Order ID will be issued at the time you place an order, it is a unique number assigned to your transaction. Tracking ID will be issued at the time your order is dispatched, this ID will be used to track your order and the status of delivery. Courier company details will be shared with you once the order is dispatched and you can track your order on their website or portal after that.

settings.question: How many times does the courier service agent attempt to deliver my order?
settings.answer: You will be contacted by the courier service agent 8 hours before the delivery time, if you fail to receive your order on your doorstep, the agent will attempt to contact you again. Your order will be automatically cancelled if you fail to receive the order the second time as well.

settings.question: Can I add more items to my existing order?
settings.answer: You will have to place a new order and cannot add more items to the order that has been processed. You can edit your order before the order is dispatched by using your Order ID, please contact our customer service immediately.

settings.question: Does adding an item to the cart means that the item is reserved?
settings.answer: Just adding the product in the cart does not mean the product is reserved. The product is not yours until you pay for it and place an order.

settings.question: What is the difference between ‘add to wishlist’ and ‘add to cart’?
settings.answer: Add to wishlist" means you like the product and may consider buying it sometime later but not right now; whereas, when you add a product to the cart, it means that you are serious about buying the product and that you are just a few steps away from making the payment.

settings.question: What payment options are available?
settings.answer:
Following are the payment options available to shop at our online store;

⦁ Cash on Delivery (For domestic clients only)
⦁ Online payment

settings.question: What happens if my payment fails?
settings.answer: The order will only be processed once the payment has been received in our account. If you’re unable to make the online payment, please contact our customer service.

settings.question: What does Cash on Delivery mean?
settings.answer: If you choose Cash on Delivery as a payment method on the checkout page, it means you’ll be asked for the required amount in cash at the time of the delivery and will be provided with a receipt along with your purchase.

settings.question: Is Cash on Delivery service offered to international clients?
settings.answer: No. It is a service offered only to domestic clients.

settings.question: Can I get a refund?
settings.answer: No. Limelight strictly follows ‘No refund’ policy. Kindly, read our exchange policy for further details.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship internationally!

settings.question: Are the prices inclusive of delivery charges?
settings.answer: No. The prices are exclusive of delivery and shipping charges.

settings.question: How are the delivery charges calculated for international orders?
settings.answer: Delivery charges for international orders vary according to the weight of parcel and the region of delivery.

settings.question: Is it safe to pay with credit/debit card?
settings.answer: Yes. All payment information submitted by our customers is kept confidential. All Credit Card and Debit Card payments are processed over a secure encrypted connection, with the highest level of security and confidentiality. Only authorized personnel have the right to access this information.

settings.question: Is my personal information safe?
settings.answer: Yes, your personal information is absolutely safe, please read our Privacy Policy.
